0022600194.text: The Suns (2-5, 12th in the West) host the Rockets (7-2, 1st in the Southwest) in Phoenix's eighth game of the season, with the Suns at 2-2 at home and 0-3 on the road. Phoenix has Mark Williams out after shoulder surgery, while Jordan Goodwin (calf) and Rasheer Fleming (ankle) are day-to-day and game-time decisions. Houston has Steven Adams out with a calf strain and Clint Capela day-to-day with an ankle sprain, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27. The Suns lost all four games to the Rockets in 2025-26, most recently 119-105 in Phoenix on April 7, 2026.
